responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines the m68k backend’s RTL expanders and instruction patterns for atomic synchronization primitives. It provides compare-and-swap and test-and-set implementations using the target’s CAS and TAS instructions, with UNSPEC_VOLATILE forms that model memory side effects and boolean success results. GCC’s atomic expansion machinery uses these patterns to lower built-in atomic operations to native m68k synchronization instructions when the relevant ISA features are available.
